scope_note: Independent read-only spot-check of claims published in trip-2027/ (owner arena/b6e6976d-chinafun3). No values were copied from trip-2027 without a matching official source fetched in this session. Where a value could not be reproduced it is marked Unverified or Not reproduced and must not be treated as confirmed.

status_key.Confirmed: Value matches the official source fetched on the checked date.
status_key.Partially confirmed: Part of the claim matches; the rest could not be reproduced from an official source.
status_key.Discrepancy: Published value conflicts with the official source. Owner should correct.
status_key.Not reproduced: Official source found, but the specific value (for example a dated price) could not be reproduced on the checked date.
status_key.Unverified: No official source found in this session. Leave blank and flag.

checks.action: Official gov.cn original was not fetched directly in this sandbox. Re-check the State Council copy before booking. Some third-party pages show different 2027 dates (for example, a Baidu Baike snippet listing 15-23 Feb); these conflict with the notice and should not be used.

checks.topic: Weekday and workday status of the preferred trip dates
checks.trip_claim: Mon 15 Feb 2027 is a normal workday; Sun 21 Feb is a weekend day
checks.evidence: Calendar check: 15 Feb 2027 = Monday; 14 Feb 2027 = Sunday (make-up workday); 21 Feb 2027 = Sunday; 22 Feb 2027 = Monday; 1 Mar 2027 = Monday; 23 Mar 2027 = Tuesday. 15 Feb is outside the 5-13 Feb holiday, so it is a normal workday.

checks.topic: 240-hour visa-free transit: number of eligible countries and US eligibility
checks.trip_claim: Describes the US as one of the '55+ eligible countries' under the NIA 240-hour policy
checks.source_label: China NIA (National Immigration Administration), Visa-Free Transit Policies, dated 2026-08-20
checks.evidence: 'Currently, China is implementing this policy for nationals of 57 countries including Russia, the United Kingdom and the United States... 65 designated open exit-entry ports in 24 provinces... no more than 10 days.' United States is listed under North America.
checks.action: Owner should change '55+' to 57 and cite this NIA page. US eligibility is confirmed. Transit still requires a third-country onward ticket with a confirmed seat (NIA: 'onward tickets with confirmed seats').

checks.trip_claim: Seven-night total $2,291.93 incl. taxes (nightly base $280.81; breakfast included)
checks.source_label: MICHELIN Guide Hotels booking page, The Langham Shanghai Xintiandi, 15-22 Feb 2027, 2 adults
checks.evidence: Page shows 'Starting at $281 — $327 total with taxes per/nt' for Feb 15-22. $327 x 7 = $2,289, which is close to but not equal to $2,291.93. The per-night breakdown and breakfast inclusion were not visible in the page text captured here.
checks.action: Leave the exact total unverified until the booking engine is re-run for the chosen room and rate. Use the live page quote, not the stored figure.

checks.trip_claim: $140 per person through 31 Dec 2026; $280 for two. Reverts to $185 per person after 31 Dec 2026 if not extended.
checks.source_label: Chinese Consulate General San Francisco, Notice on Extension of Visa-Fee Reduction (dated 29 Dec 2025); same notice issued by the Chinese Embassy in the US
checks.evidence: Notice: reduced fees 'until December 31, 2026' — US citizen $140 for single, double, 6-month multiple and 12-month-plus multiple entries; express +$25 per visa. The notice does not state the post-2026 fee.
checks.action: The $140 figure applies only to applications made by 31 Dec 2026. Any visa applied for in Feb 2027 has no verified fee on this source; leave the post-2026 amount unverified and flag it. The $185 standard figure appears only in secondary guides and is not verified here.

checks.topic: Which Chinese mission serves Texas (relevant to a Dallas applicant)
checks.trip_claim: Trip data refers to US consulates for L-visa applications
checks.source_label: Chinese Embassy in the US, Requirements and Procedures for Chinese Visa Application (updated 22 Sep 2025)
checks.evidence: Consular jurisdiction of the Embassy in Washington D.C. includes ... Oklahoma, Texas, Puerto Rico. Applicants must confirm they live in the listed states before applying.
checks.action: For a Dallas, Texas applicant, the Washington D.C. embassy is listed as the consular jurisdiction in this notice (the notice also says the New COVA system is used). Confirm with the embassy before applying; the Sep 2025 notice may have been updated since.
